sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:8

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:8:1
items.html: The state we are in, which is two lights without vessels: For here the male and the female are found in a state of ascent, on account of the refinement of the screen from all the coarseness that was in it, which equalised its form with the Emanator entirely, as above. And this male and female of Keter are nothing but quiet records, in which there is no coarseness at all; only that because they were previously in a state of clothing in the Guf [body] — this one in the level of Keter of the Guf and that one in the level of Hochma in the Guf — we therefore call them male and female, as above. And this is what the ARI is precise to inform us of here, “that they are two lights without vessels, which are the ZON of Keter that rose upward.” That is, as explained, that there is nothing whatsoever of the aspect of vessels in these ZON, they being in the secret of ascent.
